name: datgold-mcp-runtime
description: Build-time dependency closure of the MCP client SDK, and of the server SDK with its Node HTTP adapter (the Hub's MCP server), that the installer stages into DATGOLD-HUB/runtimes/mcp (stage.mjs). The Hub loads them lazily (lib/mcp/sdk.mjs, lib/mcp/server-sdk.mjs) and keeps no runtime dependency of its own. Never install on end-user machines.
